description: The text of a PDF article as Mathpix read it and people put it right, page by page — Markdown with $…$ formulas, each piece with the page of the original it is from, at most 30 pages a call ('nextPage' says where to go on). Each page has its 'version' and its 'state': 'machine' (as Mathpix read it), 'checked' (a person checked it against the original), 'human' (edited by a person) or 'agent' (edited by an agent); 'front' marks a cover or title page. Name the file by 'fileId' (list_pdf_copies, search_pdf_texts) or by 'pageId' + 'filename'. The original is what counts — check a formula you rely on against pdf_page_image of the same page, and put a page right with update_pdf_text. A file not yet read says so.

filename.description: The PDF's name on that page.

pageId.description: Wiki page id, with 'filename', instead of fileId.

pages.description: A page or a range: '5', '3-7', '12-'. Every page without.

name: read_pdf_text
title: Read pdf text
